intro: A mobile developer resume built on apps people use: store ratings, installs, crash rates and performance.
tips: Name the apps, with installs and store ratings.
Show crash rate, start time or battery wins.
Say which platforms and frameworks: native, cross-platform or both.

basics.name: Kenji Watanabe
basics.label: Mobile Developer
basics.summary: Mobile developer with six years building iOS and Android apps in Swift, Kotlin and React Native. I care about fast starts, smooth scrolling and a crash-free release.

work.name: Tabearuki
work.summary: Restaurant discovery app, 5 million installs, rated 4.7.
highlights: Rewrote the iOS app in SwiftUI; cold start fell from 2.8 s to 1.1 s.
Cut the crash rate from 1.2% to 0.15% of sessions with better error handling and monitoring.
Led the move to a shared React Native layer for booking, used by both apps.

work.name: AppWorks
work.summary: Agency building apps for retail clients.
highlights: Built six Android apps in Kotlin for clients with up to 1 million users.
Introduced automated UI tests with Espresso.
